main_text.p: extremorum æqualiter distat ab aliquo puncto- rum Cardinalium. Ascensio Leonis æquatur ascen- sioni Tauri intermedij, qui cum aquario compa- ratus ab æquinoctio uerno, cum Leone à principio Cancri æquali disidet spacio.
main_text.head: SECVNDVM πόρισμα.
main_text.p: Descensio signi in sphæra recta conuenit cum ascensione eiusdem. Quæ enim est habitudo par- tium Eclipticæ ab ortu uersus Meridianum, eadem est earundem inclinatio à Meridiano ad cardi- nem occiduum. Cum igitur oppositi arcus declina- tiones ab æquatore uersus oppositos polorum mundi cardines æquales sortiantur, & ad omnes Horizontis partes secundum eosdem applicentur angulos, necesse est eas eodem tempore occumbe- re, quo oriuntur, adeoq; ascensione cognita descen- sionem etiam rectum innotescere.

page.notes: Two diagrams: left, a sphere with points B, F, E, I, H, G, D, C, A; right, a sphere with points B, G, H, I, K, C, A. Letters in the diagrams are not transcribed as text. The Greek heading "πόρισμα" is printed with an accent mark as shown. "REGV-" is the signature-like word at lower right, printed as is.
